notes.title: Amber Throne Soundtrack!
notes.notes:
Hey all! Jasmine Cooper, AT's composer has uploaded the full and extended AT soundtrack to her bandcamp, here: https://jcoopmusic.bandcamp.com/album/the-amber-throne

You can listen to all of it for free, or pay what you want for a downloadable version! Tons of music, regardless.
Enjoy!

notes.title: Amber Throne Now Available!
notes.notes:
Thanks everyone a ton for checking out AT, helping us through greenlight, and everything else! Amber Throne is now available and will be 10% off for the next week! Hope you'll enjoy what we've made.
Steam cards are coming very soon, and I'll be around to fix any bugs if need be!
